verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so cold-start latency is a fair axis. The pack has no documented claim or measurement of startup or time-to-first-inference, and nothing describing a lightweight runtime binary. The small model files, low-end hardware support, Homebrew install and community reports of fast inference describe footprint and throughput, not cold start. The one startup-adjacent comment (comm-18) describes models downloading inline at runtime with a blocking first run, which does not show fast cold start.
